title: Freight Forwarder Carrier Liability for Sea-Transit Salt Corrosion
workplace_track: Export Logistics & Incoterms 2020 (EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DDP)
description: Intermediate sales and logistics module analyzing freight forwarder carrier liability for sea-transit salt corrosion.
learning_objectives: Master professional Past Perfect for Sequence of Damage in technical sales and export contracts
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in freight forwarder carrier liability for sea-transit salt corrosion
Demonstrate mastery in international negotiations and Incoterms documentation

questions.prompt: By the time the container vessel docked at Alexandria port, the irrevocable letter of credit (L/C) _____ by the issuing bank.

explanations.correct: Past Perfect Passive ('had been issued') correctly expresses an action completed prior to the past docking event.
explanations.wrong_A: Past Simple ('was issued') does not show priority before past docking.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Perfect ('has been issued') cannot connect to a completed past narrative.
explanations.wrong_D: 'didn't issue' is active voice; commercial documents are acted upon passively.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech narrative uses past tense for both ('než loď přistála, akreditiv byl otevřen'). English contracts require Past Perfect.
